sn1.33:1.1: Sāvatthi ārāme || || Atha kho sambahulā Satullapakāyikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:2.1: Sādhu kho mārisa dānaṃ || || Maccherā ca pamādā ca || evaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati || puññam ākaṅkhamānena || deyyaṃ hoti vijānatā ti || ||
sn1.33:3.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:4.1: Sādhu kho mārisa dānaṃ || api ca appasmim pi sādhu dānaṃ ||
sn1.33:5.1: Appasm-eke pavecchanti || bahun-eke na dicchare || appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā || sahassena samam mitā ti || ||
sn1.33:6.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udanesi || ||
sn1.33:7.1: Sādhu kho mārisa dānaṃ || Appasmim pi sādhu dānam || Api ca saddhāya pi sādhu dānam || Dānañca yuddhañca samānam āhu || Appāpi santā bahuke jinanti || Appam pi ce saddahāno dadāti || ten-eva so hoti sukhī paratthā ti || ||
sn1.33:8.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:9.1: Sādhu kho mārisa dānaṃ || appasmiṃ pi sādhu dānaṃ || saddhāya pi sādhu dānam || api ca dhammaladdhassa pi sādhu dānaṃ || ||
sn1.33:10.1: Yo dhammaladdhassa dadāti dānam || uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatassa jantu || atikkamma so vetaraṇiṃ Yamassa || dibbāni ṭhānāni upeti macco ti || ||
sn1.33:11.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:12.1: Sādhu kho mārisa dānaṃ || Appasmiṃ pi sādhu dānaṃ || Saddhāya pi sādhu dānaṃ || Dhammaladdhassa pi sādhu dānam || Api ca viceyyadānam pi sādhu || || Viceyyadānaṃ
sn1.33:13.1: sugatappasatthaṃ || ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke || etesu dinnāni mahapphallāni || bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette ti || ||
sn1.33:14.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavato santike imam udānam udānesi || ||
sn1.33:15.1: Sādhu kho mārisa dānam || Appasmim pi sādhu dānaṃ || Saddhāya pi sādhu dānaṃ || Dhammaladdhassa pi sādhu dānaṃ || Viceyyadānam pi sādhu || Api ca pāṇesu ca sādhu saṃyamo || ||
sn1.33:16.1: Yo pāṇabhūtesu aheṭhayaṃ caraṃ || parūpavādā na karoti pāpaṃ || bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti na hi tattha sūraṃ || bhayā hi santo na karonti pāpan ti || ||
sn1.33:17.1: Atha kho aparā devatā Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kassā nu kho Bhagavā subhāsitan ti || ||
sn1.33:18.1: Sabbāsaṃ vo subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena || api mamam pi suṇātha || ||
sn1.33:19.1: Saddhāhi dānam bahudhā pasatthaṃ || dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ va seyyo || || pubbeva hi pubbatareva santo || nibbānam ev-ajjhagamuṃ sapaññā || ||
